findings.title: Type narrowing breaks callers that pass integers
findings.body: The new signature of `normalize_sku` accepts only `str`, but `receiving.py` line 12 calls it with an `int` from `barcodes: list[int]`. This will raise `TypeError` at runtime. Restore the union type `str | int` to keep the function compatible with its callers.

summary.problem: The new signature of `normalize_sku` breaks existing callers that pass integers.
summary.done_well: The function now validates its input and documents its purpose.
